waivers.verdict: Hold. Gesicki and Houston's defense both cleared waivers, the bench and IR are now completely full, and nothing on the wire is worth freeing a spot for.

lineup.verdict: Start Houston's defense over Denver this week. Everything else holds — Kraft stays over Gesicki at TE on usage.

trades.verdict: Hold. The roster move that triggered this check (Gesicki and Houston's defense landing, Cleveland out) doesn't change the trade picture — nothing clears the bar of being certain to leave you better off.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable — Week 9's first game (Baltimore at Jacksonville, Thursday) is still a day out, so there are no inactive lists yet and nothing to check.
